create_BatchedMinNewTokensPenalizer: create a BatchedMinNewTokensPenalizer to penalize tokens based on minimum output length
test__is_required: test the _is_required method to check if any request has min_new_tokens greater than zero
build__prepare: build the _prepare method to initialize min_new_tokens, stop_token_penalties, and len_output_tokens tensors
run__apply: run the _apply method to add negative infinity penalties to stop tokens when output length is below min_new_tokens
filter_batched_penalizer: filter the batched penalizer tensors by keep_indices to remove unused request entries
